title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS, MEXICAN, FOR THE PURPOSE OF MAKING A SURVEY TO ASCERTAIN THE MOST ADVANTAGEOUS ROUTE FOR A RAILROAD INTO THE MOUNTAINS OF BENGUET, ISLAND OF LUZON, AND THE PROBABLE COST
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS, MEXICAN, FOR THE PURPOSE OF MAKING A SURVEY TO ASCERTAIN THE MOST ADVANTAGEOUS ROUTE FOR A RAILROAD INTO THE MOUNTAINS OF BENGUET, ISLAND OF LUZON, AND THE PROBABLE COST
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp năm nghìn đô la Mexico để khảo sát xác định tuyến đường sắt tối ưu vào vùng núi Benguet, đảo Luzon, và chi phí dự kiến

title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pengalokasian Lima Ribu Dolar Meksiko untuk Survei guna Menentukan Jalur Kereta Api yang Paling Menguntungkan menuju Pegunungan Benguet, Pulau Luzon, serta Biaya yang Diperkirakan
title.ms: Akta Mengenai Peruntukan Lima Ribu Dolar Mexico bagi Tujuan Mengadakan Tinjauan untuk Menentukan Laluan Keretapi yang Paling Menguntungkan ke Gunung Benguet Pulau Luzon dan Kos yang Dianggarkan

text.en:
The sum of five thousand dollars, Mexican, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, for the purpose of making
a survey to ascertain the most advantageous route for a railroad into the mountains of Benguet, Island of
Luzon, and the probable cost thereof.

The disbursing officer of the Commission is authorized and directed to draw his warrant for the
amount appropriated by this bill, or so much thereof as may be necessary, and the Insular Treasurer is
directed to pay the same.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 12, 1900.
